title: R30 Regulatory Posture Register row (Proposed, DEC-02; owner cdss-governance; mutability versioned; written by regulatory owner + external attestations only)
$comment: Companion to REG-R30_regulatory_posture_register.schema+seed.md (field list, unedited) read through R30.1 and R30.2. Field set = the md field list (reg_id, statement, status, attesting_party, blocks, cadence, source, version_stamp) + owner (register law §12.1(1)) + blocker (HALT-TYPED crosswalk, REG-POSTURE §0.7) + jurisdiction (R30.2) + source_status_verbatim / mapping_pending (the status mapping for 'standing' obligations and WATCH cadences is the regulatory owner's call — survey-2 BSQ-0208; rows ship with the verbatim source wording preserved and status OPEN until ruled). No ASSUME status is changed by this schema or its seed (EX-7; MAK-ANT §8). Built 2026-09-05 (sprint-1, BSQ-0202).

reg_id.description: R30 base families (REG-POSTURE) + R30.1 extension (NDG, NZ-*, SD, SG, EX, REG-KEEP; V* sprint ids per REG-SPRINT-1.1 D-5) + R30.2 extension (US-*, EU-*, NZ-STD, NZ-GATE, STD)

statement.description: verbatim from source (the defining table row's statement cell, or the first defining prose line for legacy-shape ids)

status.description: register-lifecycle enum per REG-R30 field list and REG-POSTURE §0.7 crosswalk

source_status_verbatim.description: the status word(s) used at source (e.g. 'standing', 'not started', 'quarterly', 'proposed-normative'); never altered, only mapped

mapping_pending.description: true where the crosswalk from source_status_verbatim to the enum is not defined by REG-POSTURE §0.7 and awaits the regulatory owner's ruling (BSQ-0208)

blocker.description: HALT-TYPED crosswalk: the typed halt reason (REG-POSTURE §0.7)

cadence.description: WATCH rows only — review cadence verbatim

source.description: document and section that defines the row (MAK-ANT § / REG-POSTURE § / REG-NZ § / REG-US § / REG-EU § / MAK-GOV § / REG-SPRINT § / EXEC-1 §)

definition_shape.description: how the source defines the id; 'prose' marks the twelve v1.1-era legacy-shape AU ids recorded in REG-POSTURE v1.2 §12.2 check 2

owner.description: register owner (cdss-governance) or the row's named owner role

jurisdiction.description: R30.2: rows seeded before R30.2 are AU unless their prefix is NZ-; programme-level families (NDG, SG, SD, V*, EX) inherit AU by that rule

version_stamp.description: lockfile pin-set — universal join key, register law §12.1(4); pre-L1 rows carry the Imago commit
